description: This file contains utility methods for managing general input/output pins in the firmware, including reading pin states, setting pin modes, and initializing input capture units, primarily on STM32 microcontrollers.

methods.name: ioportid_t getHwPort(const char * msg,brain_pin_e brainPin)
methods.description: Returns the hardware port associated with a logical pin, with error handling for invalid pin numbers.

methods.name: bool efiReadPin(brain_pin_e pin)
methods.description: Reads the current state of a specified pin.

methods.name: void efiSetPadMode(const char * msg,brain_pin_e brainPin,iomode_t mode)
methods.description: Configures the mode of a specific pin, setting error conditions if the pin is already used.

methods.name: iomode_t getInputMode(pin_input_mode_e mode)
methods.description: Returns the corresponding PAL_MODE input mode based on the specified input mode enumeration.

methods.name: void efiIcuStart(ICUDriver * icup,const ICUConfig * config)
methods.description: Starts an ICU (Input Capture Unit) driver with the provided configuration, asserting if the ICU is already in use.
